Tamil Nadu CM Reviews Monsoon Preparedness and Dengue Prevention

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M. K. Stalin reviewed preparedness for the Northeast monsoon and measures to prevent dengue. He directed officials to identify areas prone to sea water intrusion and coastal erosion, and to ensure weather and storm warnings reach fishermen and rehabilitation centers. Separately, State Environment Minister T. M. Anbarasan stated at The Hindu Sustainability Summit 2026 that sustainability must be integrated into Tamil Nadu's growth strategy, linking climate change and environmental protection with economic development and job creation.
